description: Places a pre-order drafted with draft_preorder, exactly as drafted: holds the time slot and creates the order. When an amount is due now, the result includes a payment link to WaitApp's payment page where the guest sees the exact charge and pays it themselves; this tool charges nothing. The held slot is released and the order cancelled if the amount due now is not paid in time. If anything fails part-way the slot is released and nothing is charged. Retrying with the same draftId never creates a second order. track_order follows the order by orderCode.
name: place_preorder
title: Place a drafted pre-order
